verses.28: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the
verses.29: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.30: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.31: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.32: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.33: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.34: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.35: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.36: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
